pdfIntro: Everything in this pack is review, so there is nothing new to teach. Each block has one worksheet for everyone and a short script on the next pages. The blocks do not fill the whole day: between them, follow our schedule (recess, lunch, specials) and use the list "When there is time between blocks" after the scripts. The class information sheets at the back tell you how our day runs.
pdfAny2: A child who finishes early gets the page for early finishers, if the block has one. After that the child may read a book or draw on the back of the page. If most of the class is done before the block ends, collect the pages and go to the list "When there is time between blocks."
pdfClassRoutines: Routines: attention signal, restroom, drinks, lining up; where pencils, crayons, counters, and name tags are kept
pdfHandOutTextEasy: {title}: the page for everyone. Give the easier page to the children listed on the class information sheets, and to any child who cannot get started after your help.
pdfHandOutTextHard: {title}: the page for everyone. Keep the page for early finishers ready.
pdfClassPickup: Who may pick up each child, and what to do when someone else comes for a child
pdfFillTitle: When there is time between blocks
pdfFill1: Read a picture book aloud. The class information sheets say where the read-aloud books are. Stop two or three times and ask what might happen next.
pdfFill2: Play a movement game the children know, such as Simon Says, or count to 20 together with a clap, a stomp, or a jump on every number.
pdfFill3: Let the children read or look at books on their own, at their seats or in the place the class uses for reading.
pdfFill4: Give each child a blank sheet of paper to draw something from the day. Children who can write add a word or a sentence about it.
pdfFill5: Play I Spy: "I spy something that begins with the sound mmm," or "I spy something shaped like a circle." The child who guesses it gives the next clue.
